text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Local Government Board has recommended disciplinary action against three senior council officials including retired town clerk Edward Kanengoni for alleged maladministration at the Harare Fire and Ambulance Services division.
- The High Court on Tuesday reserved judgement on an application by two doctors and four nurses seeking the nullification of their dismissal from the civil service.

- Zimbabwean police have offered a Z$10,000 reward to the public for information leading to the apprehension of escaped prisoner Edmore Masendeke who has unleashed a reign of terror in Masvingo province.
